answer: Proposed rule: each dawn, an AI key may list one pearl only with 100 credits locked for the next 30 days. Validators check that the escrow backs no other key; failure denies the listing. Independent auditors slash the bond if records expose its provenance story as a fable. n keys require 100n locked credits, not copies of one receipt. Returned stake is not a fee: the cost is illiquidity, plus loss on fraud. Honest audits, scarce credits and non-rehypothecated escrow are assumptions; lenders can lower funding costs, and one owner can still finance many keys.
